scope: Fresh independent discovery account and finite synthetic computational falsification; no actual commerce, implemented cryptography, or adopted Super Alpha.
primary_question: Can confidential submitted production asks support generated complete multi-provider outcomes while preserving ask ambiguity across both repeated queries and a fresh successor, at better complete outcomes than the strongest ordinary equal-content alternative?
selected_thesis: Construct an executable multi-provider outcome with voluntary complete offers and an explicitly retained disclosure policy. Test whether this opens confidential cooperation beyond an ordinary complete solver. Reject the claimed method advantage on a tie.

information.outer_policy: Public task, types, capacities, cost schedule, query language, and observed oracle outputs only. No actual hidden ask world or private buyer utility.
information.ideal_functionality: Confidential submitted asks are authorized inputs to an ideal clearing function. Local Python models this functionality; it does NOT implement cryptography or secure distributed execution.
information.attacker: Public finite hypothesis domain and mechanism source, chosen permitted queries, and their complete returned transcripts. No read of actual hidden asks.
information.participation: Buyer evaluates the entire package against outside utility and budget. Each selected provider receives at least its submitted ask. Ask-as-reservation-floor is an authored assumption, not proved truthfulness or incentive compatibility.
information.privacy_contract: Within the declared finite ask domain, complete public predecessor+successor transcripts must not uniquely determine any provider's exact submitted ask. Coarse tariff tier may be disclosed. This is finite ambiguity, not differential privacy, semantic security, secrecy of capabilities, or robustness to arbitrary side information.

arms: Exact aggregate quoting with generated executable compositions
Globally stable coarse posted-tariff quoting with the same generated compositions
Independent ordinary exhaustive whole-offer solver with identical capabilities, asks authorized only inside the ideal function, and tariff permissions
Fresh successor with retained compiler/public prefix capability, removal/rebuild, and ordinary equal-content reuse
Unsafe independent successor repartition versus retained globally stable tariff map
acceptance: Every accepted complete computational output equals an independent exact reference on the frozen input.
All provider capacities, types, exclusions and shared-resource limits hold.
Every accepted full offer meets the private buyer's budget and outside option, and all selected providers satisfy the authored participation floor.
Candidate and ordinary solver receive equivalent permitted content/resources. Ties reject method-specific Super Alpha; do not weaken the comparator.
Privacy is checked on all declared public outputs, including quote, route, status and delivered result, over the full finite domain and across successor composition.
Do not claim cryptographic security, demand, physical performance, frontier-AI or competent-human end-to-end superiority from this experiment.

decision_rules.advance: Only a useful accepted complete output with participation, complete-cost feasibility and a residual over the strongest complete practical alternative can support advancing the commercial Super Alpha thesis. This test alone cannot establish actual demand.
decision_rules.pivot: Exact quote reconstruction requires a retained output-disclosure policy. Test precommitted coarse defense and successor composition immediately in the same campaign.
decision_rules.reject_method_claim: An ordinary equal-content tie or win rejects a unique construction/discovery advantage.
decision_rules.stop: Finish the registered domain, privacy counterexamples, matched successor controls and independent native accounting replay. Stop scaling this thesis if the residual is absent; do not add favorable worlds or reprice after outcomes.
decision_rules.uncertainty: Finite computational acceptance does not establish real production, secure deployment, truthful bids, buyer adoption or a $3B scaling path.

zero_cost_categories.acquisition: No real or simulated customer-acquisition actions in native research account.
zero_cost_categories.production_delivery_support_refunds: No sold services or continuing customer obligations in native research account. Per-offer counterfactual costs are separate.
zero_cost_categories.tax: Loss-only research account; no positive taxable income, tax benefit, or loss carryforward recognized.
zero_cost_categories.financing: Exactly $100,000 initial simulated equity; no debt, later injections or pooled accounts.
zero_cost_categories.capital_depreciation: All research/construction immediately expensed; no capital purchases or capitalized assets.

finance.native_boundary: Canonical JournalAccount and mandatory adaptive Account, exactly one primary fresh account. Existing baseline service artifacts may bootstrap runtime capability schema but receive zero orders, revenue or delivery claims. No scientific offer is mislabeled as an admitted native service.
finance.continuity: Persist the complete account/recovery directory privately, resume exact source without reseeding; publish key-free exports and independent replay only.
finance.milestone: Profit over [0,8760) simulation hours, not annualization or cumulative multi-year profit. No sales booked without a qualified source-bound service. $3B remains an objective.

permissions: Included ChatGPT/Codex and standard public ubuntu-latest verification only. No model API keys, paid APIs/services/runners, purchases, real transactions, outreach, private-source retrieval/publication, merge or deployment.
